data.one_liner: Flutter debug view to monitor network logs, response times and share logs.
data.what_it_does: Collects, views, and monitors network logs directly inside a Flutter app. It provides a visual debug interface and integrates with Dio to track requests and responses.
use_when: You want QA engineers and project managers to easily inspect network traffic inside the app.
Your networking layer is built using the Dio package.
avoid_when: Your network requests do not go through the Dio library.
You are using a Flutter version older than 3.47.0 (unless using version 1.4.x).
strengths: Streamlines testing and debugging workflow for QA and PMs.
Allows sharing of network logs outside of the app.
weaknesses: Strictly depends on Dio for network logging.
Requires a high minimum Flutter version (3.47.0+).
data.setup_notes: Wrap your app with the DebugView widget providing a navigatorKey and add the NetworkLoggerInterceptor to your Dio instance.

alternatives.name: pretty_dio_logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer logging network requests directly to the console instead of an in-app UI view.

alternatives.name: talker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a comprehensive logging and debugging tool that covers more than just network requests.
